title: PlayerCore: Important Systems
summary: Recognize homes, back locations, spawn, random teleport, TPA, warps, cooldowns, and safety checks.

blocks.title: Travel Anchors
blocks.body: Homes are personal anchors. Spawn is a shared fallback. Warps are server-managed anchors. Back and death locations are recovery tools.

blocks.title: Social Travel
blocks.body: TPA depends on another player accepting the route. Use it when coordination is safer than wandering or random teleporting.

blocks.title: Safety Rules
blocks.body: Random teleport and normal teleports can check dimensions, blocks, height ranges, lava, water, powder snow, cactus, and server-defined hazards.

blocks.title: State Check
blocks.body: Use the system note to read the current state, then choose one action that answers it.
